radius.$description: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED — no dedicated Figma foundation page for border-radius exists, but 'sm' and 'md' are now confirmed directly via live Figma design context across many components. lg/xl/2xl are still inferred from arbitrary rounded-[Npx] values in the 5 codebases and need an explicit design decision.

sm.$description: Confirmed across Button (all variants/sizes), Input Field/Box, Modal, Accordion (implicit, no radius), File Upload Prompt, Tab/Pill, Side Nav Item, List Field Right Content button, and Table Leading Cell's icon container. The single most-evidenced token in this file.

md.$description: Confirmed via Button Group (the rounded corners of a segmented control), Stat, and Tooltip — all three independently use exactly 8px.

full.$description: Confirmed via Avatar (circular, literal Figma value 100px which renders identically to 9999px at any realistic size), Badge (24px on a 32px-tall pill — over-rounded to guarantee a full pill regardless of height), and Form Control Switch.
